parts.label: Two gets
parts.prompt: Same values in a queue: 7, 8, 3, 1, 6. Which two numbers does get() return?

fields.label: first get()
fields.hint: A queue serves the front — the first value that went in.

traps.hint: 6 is at the back. get() takes from the front.

fields.label: second get()
fields.hint: After 7 leaves, the front is the next arrival.

traps.hint: Do not confuse queue order with stack order from task 07_1.
